visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt and dark pants vigorously lifts a woman wearing a pink tank top and white patterned pajama pants from a bed. The setting is a bright, clean bedroom with a large navy blue tufted headboard, white walls, and a window with white sheer curtains. A large text overlay in blue and white sans-serif font is positioned at the top of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit white bathroom with a closed white door in the background. The man stands behind the woman, using a white toothbrush to brush her teeth for her. The woman has her long dark hair partially pulled up into a messy bun and looks directly into the camera with a resigned, neutral expression. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clinical white surfaces of the bathroom. (3) Back in a bedroom setting with the blue tufted headboard, the man holds the woman's head steady while applying makeup to her cheek using a large fluffy brush. The woman sits passively while the man focuses intensely on the application. The lighting is soft and natural, coming from a nearby window. The man is wearing a red beaded bracelet on his left wrist. (4) In a modern kitchen with white cabinets and a stainless steel refrigerator, the woman sits at a white round table. The man, standing next to her, uses a spoon to feed her a bite of food from a white ceramic bowl. The woman opens her mouth to accept the food while looking off-camera. Various kitchen items like a spray bottle and spice jars are visible on the table in the foreground. (5) The man, now wearing a striped apron over his black t-shirt, helps the woman into a large black leather jacket. He carefully pulls the collar and sleeves into place as she stands with her arms outstretched. The background shows a white door and a fan in a simple, well-lit living area. The man's movements are quick and efficient. (6) Near a doorway, the man hands the woman a brown designer handbag and multiple plastic bags filled with pre-packed food containers. He adjusts her jacket one last time. A white dog sits on the floor nearby. The woman carries her belongings toward the exit while the man remains in the apron, appearing as a domestic helper. (7) Inside a car parked outdoors, the man leans through the open driver-side door to buckle the woman's seatbelt as she sits in the driver's seat. He is still wearing his striped apron. After securing the belt, he leans in to give her a quick kiss on the cheek. Several food containers and bags are visible on the passenger seat and center console. (8) The final scene shows the man standing in a driveway framed by tall, lush green hedges. He waves both arms enthusiastically toward the camera, which is positioned as if from the interior of a moving car driving away. He has a broad, cheerful smile on his face, contrasting with the woman's earlier neutral demeanor. The sunlight is bright and clear.
